title: Coordinate truth table evaluation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $w$ be a Boolean string of length $n$, and let $j$ be one of its coordinates. Evaluating the $j$th coordinate truth table at the index assigned to $w$ gives the sign corresponding to the bit $w_j$.
